canonicalization: Reproduce existing teacher_key/_feed/_array typed length-delimited stream exactly: preserve dict insertion order, scalar types/missing/IEEEbytes and array dtype/shape/C-order. Component hashes auxiliary; do not replace whole stream with combined hashes, raw rows or64-bit shortcuts.

required_components.rows: Actual ordered fitting positional rows with dtype/shape plus explicit scope namespace; source split/parent mapping SHA separately.
required_components.X_index: Actual CatBoost-prepared fitting X index type, names and ordered index values.
required_components.X_schema: Unique ordered names, each dtype, pandas categorical ordered flag/category universe if any, categorical feature list/order.
required_components.X_values: Every actual CatBoost-prepared fitting column in row order: numeric float32 conversion, NaN/inf/missing sentinels, exact string bytes. No raw-data/selected-feature-hash substitute.
required_components.y: Actual transformed fitting fit_y consumed by teacher (log1p only when runtime qualifies), target name/dtype/index names+values and ordered values. Not raw y for a log-target teacher.
required_components.weights: ExplicitNone or consumed ordered type/dtype/shape/value bytes. Classification from original fitting y/class_weight_power; regressionNone.
required_components.teacher_settings: Exact teacher_recipe,kind,threads,fixed100iterations,categorical order,selection top_k/protect_original/ordered protected columns and explicit inner/outer/full/calibration scope.
required_components.libraries: Existing key Python version/implementation,numpy,pandas,CatBoost plus separately pinned full runtime/student library and source inventory.
required_components.transitive_semantics: Full recipe/spec/source context SHA incl selector,CatBoost adapter,preprocessor,worker,FE,encoding/history/weights,module mapping. Actual history_min_periods (not old collector typo history_minimum_periods). Do not treat a parameter subset as exact identity.
required_components.effective_params: Actual teacher.get_params digest on normalfit/miss; hit references earlier same-key source-miss receipt in same leaf. Do not construct a new teacher only for telemetry.

per_request: wholekey and component digests,source/library/context SHA,row/column count
hit origin miss reference and importance digest; finite shape/rank/orderedselected columns on each request
student fit counts, ordered parents, selected iteration tree, stopping/calibration status/factors
scope_plumbing: Future common probe must receive actual explicit cache_scope in BOTH arms; current OFF does not pass cache_scope to selector because it has no cache. Do not infer OFF scopeNone or enable a cache merely to get telemetry.
fair_cost: Identical independent common full-input probe runs on every selector request in BOTH arms including ONhits. ON still pays separate existing cache.lookup keyhash/lookup/store. Commonprobe must not provide free cache key/payload or skip work onhits. Normal nonpilot defaultOFF remains nohash/no telemetry.
legacy_timer_note: teacher_fit_seconds starts BEFORE create_model and ends AFTER feature_importances_ extraction. Preserve truthfully as inclusive; do not call purefit. Unknown/failed timing null. A true hit may record invokedfalse/purefit0 for an omitted invocation, never failed quality0 or proven wall saving.
payload: Compact digests/count/schema/importance only. Do not retain or serialize raw fitting values/y/weights/model. Cache payload unchanged4/262144; source collector overhead/memory included.

conditional_prediction.each_class_callback: If actual full inner keys repeat as old metadata suggests:6requests/2leaves; OFF6teacherfits,ON4fits+2hits. Student fitting unchanged. Not preverified exactkey equality.
conditional_prediction.no_matching_keys: Inconclusive/no eligible reuse; never relax scope/addcrossworkerreuse.
